value.text: A new supported place insert and its request_outbox event are written in one PostgreSQL transaction. ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING means a duplicate place does not create another event. Refresh of a found place creates a new outbox event in its own transaction. The payload contains a new GUID, type place.requested, version 1, and the Place, serialized with web JSON defaults. RequestPublisher selects one eligible unpublished row in created_at order with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED, sends it to weather.place-requested with Place.Id as the Kafka key, then marks the row published and commits. A failure after Kafka accepts the event but before the database commit can lead to a replay; producer idempotence does not make the Kafka send and database update one transaction.
